title: The Empty Inheritance
author: Wren Marchetti
blurb: Theo Eastwick, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
